NeedDef.description: The Gray do not need normal food, but they must consume energy to keep their nanites running. They replenish it by consuming raw metal (every 1 kg provides 0.1 nutrition). They do not die even when energy reaches zero, but spare Nanite no longer regenerates naturally, and all functions related to spare Nanite stop working—including healing and abilities.
NeedDef.label: Nanite energy
